summary: Added launch-time --scene-light-intensity-scale support to both flashlight entry points. Existing scene lights are scaled before the co-located flashlight is spawned, so the spawned flashlight intensity is not affected. The option defaults to 1.0, rejects non-finite or negative values, and allows 0.0 as dim-to-off. Documentation and validation tests were updated.
work_completed: Added --scene-light-intensity-scale to examples/flashlight/run.py with default 1.0 and finite non-negative validation.
Refactored examples/flashlight/run.py argument parsing into parse_args(argv=None) so defaults and invalid values can be unit tested without launching SPEAR.
Added scene light intensity scaling helpers to examples/flashlight/run.py and applied them only when --disable-scene-lights is not set, before spawning Debug/CameraFlashlight.
Added --scene-light-intensity-scale to examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py with default 1.0 and finite non-negative validation.
Applied scene light intensity scaling in both orbit collection teleop and render startup paths before spawning the orbit collection flashlight actors.
Kept --disable-scene-lights behavior intact by preserving the existing visibility-disabling path and skipping intensity scaling when scene lights are disabled.
Updated tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py for run.py and orbit collection defaults, 0.0 acceptance, and rejection of negative, nan, and inf scene-light scale values.
Updated examples/flashlight/README.md with cafeteria_500sqft_v2 commands using --scene-light-intensity-scale 0.2 and 0.1 rather than --disable-scene-lights, including orbit teleop.
